project_goal.primary_goal: Help Codex design and build a real standalone transcription app using the user's already-working ffmpeg + whisper.cpp workflow.
project_goal.clarification: This conversation mostly focused on converting existing local audio/video files into WAV and transcribing them with whisper.cpp, not primarily on YouTube downloading. However, this workflow is directly reusable inside a future YouTube transcription app.
project_goal.core_architecture_idea: A YouTube URL should ultimately become a local media file that passes through the same local transcription pipeline already proven to work.

important_high_level_design_principle.main_point: The app should not be designed around YouTube captions.
important_high_level_design_principle.correct_design: The app should use local Whisper transcription through whisper.cpp.
important_high_level_design_principle.implication: yt-dlp should only handle acquisition/downloading. ffmpeg and whisper.cpp should handle the actual transcription pipeline.

existing_working_pipeline.overview: The user already has a reliable manual workflow for transcription using ffmpeg and whisper.cpp on macOS Apple Silicon.
pipeline_steps: Convert/extract audio to WAV using ffmpeg
Generate TXT and SRT transcript outputs

step_1_convert_audio.purpose: Convert compressed audio into 16 kHz mono WAV format optimized for whisper.cpp transcription.

step_2_transcribe_audio.command: ~/Downloads/whisper.cpp/build/bin/whisper-cli -m ~/Downloads/whisper.cpp/models/ggml-medium.bin -f "lab12-genetics.wav" -osrt -otxt --max-len 80 -of "lab12-genetics-transcript" --prompt "This is General Biology I Lab 12 on genetics. The end goal is completing the genetics pre-lab and post-lab exercises. Key topics include Mendelian inheritance, Law of Segregation, Law of Independent Assortment, diploid, haploid, allele, dominant, recessive, genotype, phenotype, homozygous, heterozygous, monohybrid cross, Punnett square, P generation, F1 generation, F2 generation, sorghum genetics, green seedlings, white seedlings, red seedlings, chlorophyll, dominant allele, recessive allele, expected phenotype ratios, observed results, chi-square analysis, X squared, hypothesis testing, deviation, expected values, and Dragon Genetics with wings, horns, homologous chromosomes, meiosis, fertilization, independent assortment, genetic linkage, W allele, w allele, H allele, h allele, WwHh mother, wwhh father, eggs, sperm, zygotes, and baby dragon phenotypes."

why_user_uses_it: Works reliably on Apple Silicon Mac
Reliable for long biology lecture/lab recordings

critical_whisper_model_issue.problem_encountered: Commands and scripts repeatedly assumed English-only Whisper models existed on the machine.
critical_whisper_model_issue.real_problem: The .en models were not installed on the user's machine, causing transcription failures and confusion.

important_technical_difference.user_setup: The user primarily uses multilingual non-.en models.

symptoms_seen: Confusion around why whisper-cli would not run
requirements_for_codex: Remember the last successful model path.
Display the active model clearly in the UI.
Warn clearly if a configured model is missing.
recommended_model_detection_logic: Fallback to first compatible discovered model

frequently_used_whisper_flags.--prompt: Inject vocabulary/context to improve recognition accuracy

biology_transcription_context.related_project: General Biology I Spring 2026 simulation project
biology_transcription_context.reason_domain_prompts_are_used: Whisper performs better when biology-specific vocabulary is included in prompts.

important_lessons_from_this_chat: The proven workflow is local media -> WAV -> whisper.cpp.
YouTube support should simply feed files into this same backend.
The app should support local files even without YouTube.
The app should expose all subprocess errors.
The app should display progress visibly.
The app should not fail silently.
The app should support reusable prompt presets.
The app should preserve working command-line behavior under the hood.

transcription_module.purpose: Run whisper.cpp and generate transcript files

model_manager_module.purpose: Detect and manage installed Whisper models

dependency_checker_module.purpose: Verify yt-dlp, ffmpeg, whisper-cli, and models exist

output_manager_module.purpose: Manage TXT/SRT output paths and project folders

gui_logger_module.purpose: Display progress, commands, stdout/stderr, and errors

recommended_processing_pipeline: Convert media to 16 kHz mono WAV using ffmpeg

recommended_mvp_for_codex.best_first_step: Build local-file transcription first before adding YouTube support.
recommended_mvp_for_codex.reason: The local transcription workflow is already proven reliable.
second_phase: Feed downloaded file into same local transcription backend

non_negotiables: Do not rely only on YouTube captions.
Must detect installed model files dynamically.
Must preserve the proven ffmpeg + whisper.cpp workflow.

likely_best_direction.recommendation: Tauri with TypeScript frontend is likely the best long-term balance between polished UI, performance, and future Windows support.
likely_best_direction.alternative: SwiftUI is best if the app is intended to remain macOS-only.

summary_for_codex: The user already has a reliable local transcription workflow using ffmpeg and whisper.cpp on Apple Silicon macOS. This workflow converts local media into WAV and generates TXT/SRT transcripts using whisper.cpp with custom biology prompts. The future standalone app should preserve this exact backend workflow instead of relying on YouTube captions. The app should treat YouTube as just another media acquisition source. One of the most important recurring issues was incorrect assumptions about installed Whisper models, especially assuming .en model files existed when they did not. The app must dynamically detect installed models, expose logs/errors clearly, and support both local media transcription and future YouTube downloading.
